Attachment-5: Hazard & Operability Review 2 DE-FE0031937 / 0006 1.0 Introduction A preliminary Hazard & Operability (Pre-HAZOP) analysis has been done as part of the HAZOP review process. This analysis primarily focuses on the plant's hazardous materials and the generation of those in major operations. As the outcome of the Pre-HAZOP investigation, a list of hazards or generic hazardous situations has been prepared. This list is made exhaustive to take care of the worst possible situations. Potential, cause, effects, outcome, and qualitative ranking are also made for each item. 2.0 Procedure Pre-HAZOP for the envisaged project of CO capture from BF gases has been prepared following the 2 guideline of AIChE as applicable for extensive processes. i) Pre-HAZOP has been made for the following facilities: - Construction and Project related activities - Water Gas Shift Reactor (BFG compression to Quench Tower Outlet) - Carbon Capture Unit (Quench tower outlet to H RF Gas Outlet and CO Compressor 2 2 outlet) - BOP facilities (Steam and Power Generation Unit) ii) A team of process specialists, construction managers, environmental engineers, system designers, instrumentation engineers, and project managers has been formed for Pre-HAZOP analysis, review, and documentation. iii) All the relevant information, like process description, process flow diagram, layout, heat & mass balance, P&IDs, control strategy, effluent summary, site information, environmental norms, etc., has been gathered from technology suppliers or host sites or the DASTUR design team. iv) The process has been studied in detail, and a wide range of potential project risks have been identified.
